request: Fix Invalid image errors when exporting Markdown to PDF.
acceptance: Export mixed browser-supported image formats from the normal Aide Markdown menu.
Preserve selectable text, visual image transparency and embedded attachments.
Recover the export controls after an image conversion error.
scope: Built-in Markdown PDF export, the vendored PDFMake PNG decoder adapter, and browser validation.

requirements.summary: GIF, WebP and linked or data URL SVG reproduced the Invalid image message. Transparent PNG could additionally stall under the current workbench CSP.

design.summary: Normalize unsupported browser-decoded images to PNG for PDF. Use the bundled synchronous inflater for PNG decoding and preserve the application CSP.

implementation.summary: Preserve supported source image bytes, inline vectors, printable geometry, limits, attachments and normal export error cleanup.

verification.summary: Chromium and WebKit passed the authenticated export workflow with exact locally served candidate assets. Poppler confirmed six images, searchable Chinese and English, alpha, and a matching embedded attachment. Broken images and a simulated canvas access error recovered the UI.

documentation.summary: Recorded reproducible dependency change and validation coverage.

cleanup.summary: Disposable verification service is removed after embedded-asset checks.

release.summary: Push and merge source after integration checks. No application binary publication is included.

release_authorization: The user requested the Aide implementation and source push.
rollback: Revert the Markdown PDF change and its asset revisions together.
handoff: Validated synthetic documents through the real Aide app. The user-reported original document was unavailable.
